item.title: KC-135 That Lost Its Tail In Deadly Collision Over Iraq Now At Tinker AFB Repair Shop
item.summary: The KC-135 made an emergency landing in Tel Aviv with half its tail sheared off following the collision that occurred during an Operation Epic Fury sortie. The post KC-135 That Lost Its Tail In Deadly Collision Over Iraq Now At Tinker AFB Repair Shop appeared first on TWZ .
